_what: The words and limits of the settings pages that settings-pages.tsx draws itself (a rail item whose `panel` is the key here, src/workspace/settings-panels.json). `whats_new.rows_url` is where the build publishes what is new (scripts/build-workspace.mjs, src/whats-new-rows.mjs); `most_rows` is the most posts drawn; a post's `points` are its steps, drawn as a list. `menubar.address` opens the Mac app's menu bar panel, where the item's own settings live (src/workspace/panel-settings.tsx).

menubar.title: Menu bar
menubar.body: Choose whether Trillion shows in your Mac's menu bar, how far ahead it counts down to a meeting, how long its title can be and what Quit does. These live in the menu bar panel itself, so they work even when this window is closed.

whats_new.title: What's new
whats_new.failed: What's new could not be loaded.
whats_new.empty: Nothing new has been posted yet.

look._what: Settings > Look & feel: the parts the old Look screen description placed (guide-screens.tsx LENT_PARTS), drawn here from the person's own records and the shipped look and feel rows, so the page needs no /work/api/screens/look owner (retired with the Worker, held in trillion-workshop docs/worker-retirement-port-backlog.json).
